_comment: Fiscal calendar configuration. Update these values and pass them as arguments to the Power Query functions. Power Query does not auto-read this file — it documents intent and is validated by scripts/validate_repo.py.

_notes.standard: Month-aligned calendar. Pass FiscalYearStartMonth (1-12) to fnCalendar.
_notes.445: 4+4+5 weeks per quarter. Each fiscal year = 52 weeks (53 in leap years). Anchor: nearest WeekStartDay on or before fiscalYearStartDate.
_notes.13period: 13 equal 4-week periods per year (52 weeks). FiscalQuarter column shows P01-P13.
